title: Representations of twisted quantum affine algebras
summary: We develop the representation theory of imaginary Verma modules for twisted quantum affine algebras and construct the corresponding Kashiwara algebras. The twisted case presents substantial new difficulties compared with the untwisted setting: the PBW root vectors have nontrivial orbit structure, the imaginary root spaces occur with multiplicities, and roots of unity enter essentially into the defining commutation relations.
